title: Playboy After Hef: What Happens When the Brand Outlives the House
audience: Readers who want a brand autopsy — club, magazine, mansion, licensing shell — not nostalgia or pure takedown.
metaDescription: From mansion hospitality to PLBY licensing: how Playboy survived Hefner, rejected his son’s bid, and still sells access mythology in a post-MeToo culture.
angle: Playboy is the perfect Artometrics object: a firm that sold proximity to young women as lifestyle, then tried to become pure IP. Trace club → magazine → mansion → SPAC/licensing, Cooper’s rejected bid, posthumous creep literature, and the awkward cultural afterlife (Hef cameo + Brand’s bunny in Hop) beside today’s age-gap Hollywood discourse.
